title: Ledger Coding Reference — Self-Pay Discount on the Patient Financial Account
content:
**Entry: self-pay discount.** A service whose date of service falls while the Patient Financial Account holds the Self-Pay Account tier is posted at the gross fee-schedule amount, with the line category self-pay visit (or non-covered service). On the same posting date the tier's self-pay discount percentage is taken off it by one adjustment coded as a self-pay discount. The adjustment is the charge's remaining balance multiplied by the self-pay discount percentage, rounded to the nearest cent.

**Where the entry appears.**

- Tiers whose self-pay discount percentage is 0.00 never receive it.
- The self-pay discount applies only to service lines — self-pay visit and non-covered service lines. Fees of any kind are posted at their stated amount without it.
- It is computed before any prompt-pay discount or hardship adjustment.
- It is not reversed when the patient later obtains coverage, unless the charge is rebilled as a retroactive-coverage rebill, which removes the whole remaining balance.

**Illustration (hypothetical figures).** A self-pay visit with a gross fee-schedule amount of 200.00, on a tier whose self-pay discount percentage is 35.00, carries a self-pay discount adjustment of 70.00 on its posting date, leaving 130.00. A no-show fee of 40.00 on the same account carries no self-pay discount.

| Line category | Self-pay discount on a tier with a rate above 0.00 |
|---|---|
| self-pay visit | yes |
| non-covered service | yes |
| any fee | no |
